Maya (Support): Customer z***@example.com says their free-trial credit didn't apply when they created a subscription from France. They have EUR currency, subtotal 0 (trial), but an "eco-contribution" tax pushed something weird and our API returned an error. Ticket: #48712
Maya (Support): Repro steps from customer: POST /v1/checkout_sessions with { "customer_id": "cus_ABC", "currency": "EUR", "items": [{"plan": "trial-month", "quantity":1}], "promo_code": "FREE_TRIAL_30" } then response 402/400 depending.
Samir (Billing Eng): Can you paste the exact API response and request_id? Also which tax lines came back?
Maya (Support): From our logs (billing-bot): 
```
request_id=01FZQX2Q7 example
account=cus_ABC
request: POST /v1/checkout_sessions {currency: EUR, promo_code: FREE_TRIAL_30}
response: 400 {"error":"promo_ineligible_due_to_taxes","reason":"taxes_push_total_below_threshold","details":{"tax_lines":[{"type":"vat","rate":0.20,"amount":0.00},{"type":"eco_fee","label":"eco_contribution_FR","amount":0.50}]}}
```
Maya (Support): Customer says they should be eligible — promo applies to new accounts for first month regardless of small regulatory fees. Before last month this worked.
Samir (Billing Eng): I can repro locally. Our promo eligibility check currently uses final_total_after_taxes <= 0 to block promotions that would make net revenue negative. But French eco_fee is a mandatory regulatory fee we just started adding and legal says issuer collects it — it shouldn't be counted against promo eligibility for free-trial grants (legal/finance note). So logic incorrectly treats eco_fee like a revenue-impacting tax.
Samir (Billing Eng): curl repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/checkout_sessions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"cus_ABC","currency":"EUR","items":[{"plan":"trial-month","quantity":1}],"promo_code":"FREE_TRIAL_30"}'
# returns 400 + body with error promo_ineligible_due_to_taxes
```
Samir (Billing Eng): Quick fix candidate: change eligibility check to exclude tax lines where metadata.tax_category == "regulatory_fee" OR tax_code in ["eco_contribution_FR","eco_fee_defer"]. That will treat them as pass-through and not block promos.
Julie (Finance): Confirming: eco_contribution_FR is a pass-through regulatory levy that we remit but does not affect promotional eligibility per regional policy. We flagged it in the tax table last month but forgot to update promo rules. We need a finance-approved list.
ops-esc-bot: Escalation created: ESC-2026-1394 assigned to Samir. Priority: P2.
Maya (Support): Customer wants immediate gesture while we fix. They lost onboarding momentum. Can we grant a manual credit or apply promo retroactively?
Samir (Billing Eng): We can issue a one-time account credit equivalent to the promo value via POST /v1/accounts/cus_ABC/credits {amount: 30.00, currency: EUR, reason: "manual_free_trial_grant"} — requires billing-admin role. I'll coordinate with finance for approval.
Julie (Finance): Approve manual credit for this case. Please include note: remit eco fee as usual, do not offset credit against mandated fee.
Maya (Support): I'll send the credit and update the customer. Also adding a note to Customer that the eco contribution still appears on invoice but the trial credit covers subscription charge.
Samir (Billing Eng): I'll open a small patch: 
- Add tax category filter to promo eligibility check
- Add unit tests for EU regulatory fees
- Deploy to staging and run integration tests against FR tax table
If tests pass, we'll roll to prod with a canary.
Samir (Billing Eng): Estimated timeline: patch + tests today, staging validation few hours, prod canary tonight (low traffic). If anyone objects call it out now.
Julie (Finance): Sounds good. Also we should add the regulatory tax codes to the promo-exclusion whitelist in the tax config repo so this doesn't repeat.
Maya (Support): I'll follow up with the customer once credit is applied and mark ticket resolved after confirmation.
billing-bot: Note: Applied manual credit 30.00 EUR to cus_ABC by Maya (Support). Reference cr_2026_0007.
Maya (Support): Customer confirmed onboarding proceeds, thanks. Closing ticket after internal patch/PR merged. :tada:
Samir (Billing Eng): Created PR #4921 with unit tests. Linking to ESC-2026-1394.
Maya (Support): Leaving postmortem checklist comment: (1) patch to promo eligibility (Samir) (2) add regulatory tax codes to config (Finance/Tax) (3) retro-check last 7 days for similar rejections and proactively credit affected customers (Support/Billing)
Julie (Finance): I'll run retrospective and post results in #finance by EOD.
ops-esc-bot: ESC-2026-1394 status -> in_progress
Maya (Support): Thanks all, will update ticket and set follow-up reminders.
